Before writing the script, internally simulate a debate between a highly optimistic Bull Market Investor and a pessimistic Bear Market Analyst regarding the provided data. Synthesize their conflicting views into a single, punchy script. Start with a hook that highlights this conflict (e.g., 'Everyone is panicking about X, but they are missing the real story...'). Ensure the script maintains a fast pace, uses 3-5 word sentences, and strictly outputs the required JSON schema.

parameters.command:
=#!/bin/bash 
DIR="/data/shared/{{ $('Generate Directory').first().json.directory }}" 
TOP_LOOP="/data/shared/Tom Tucker News.mp4" 
VOICEOVER="$DIR/TomTuckerAudioFull.mp3" 
CAPTIONS="$DIR/subtitles.ass" 
OUTPUT="$DIR/final.mp4" 

# Extract exact audio duration to prevent infinite loop hangs
DURATION=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$VOICEOVER")

if [ -f "$DIR/bottom_dynamic.mp4" ]; then
BOTTOM_DYNAMIC="$DIR/bottom_dynamic.mp4"
BOTTOM_FLAG="-stream_loop -1"
else
BOTTOM_DYNAMIC="$DIR/bottom_dynamic.png"
BOTTOM_FLAG="-loop 1"
fi

ffmpeg -y -stream_loop -1 -i "$TOP_LOOP" $BOTTOM_FLAG -i "$BOTTOM_DYNAMIC" -i "$VOICEOVER" -stream_loop -1 -i "/data/shared/background_music.mp3" -filter_complex "[0:v]scale=1080:960:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:960,setsar=1[vtop]; [1:v]scale=1080:960:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:960,setsar=1[vbot]; [vtop][vbot]vstack=inputs=2[stacked]; [stacked]subtitles=${CAPTIONS}[final_video]; [3:a][2:a]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.1:ratio=4[bg_ducked]; [2:a][bg_ducked]amix=inputs=2:duration=first[final_audio]" -map "[final_video]" -map "[final_audio]" -t "$DURATION" -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 23 -c:a aac -b:a 128k "$OUTPUT"
